title: The 100th day from today
observableEvidence: Determines the day of the week a fixed number of days after a given day, using the remainder from dividing by 7.
prompt: Today is a Wednesday. What day of the week will it be 100 days from today?
solutionRepresentation: 100 divided by 7 leaves a remainder of 2 (since 7 × 14 = 98). Counting 2 days forward from Wednesday gives Friday.
solutionMethod: Divide the number of days by 7 to find the remainder, then count that many days of the week forward from the starting day.

deterministicValidator.equivalenceNotes: Accept any capitalization of the day name.

hintSteps.prompt: The days of the week repeat every 7 days, so only the remainder after dividing by 7 matters.
hintSteps.question: What is 100 divided by 7, and what is the remainder?

hintSteps.prompt: That remainder tells you how many days of the week forward to count from Wednesday.
hintSteps.question: If the remainder is 2, what two days come right after Wednesday?

hintSteps.prompt: This works the same way a clock's hour hand repeats every 12 hours — only the leftover amount after full cycles changes the final position.
hintSteps.question: What day do you land on after counting the remainder forward from Wednesday?
